title: Challenge 3 - MicroPython Trojan models: build + verbatim cross-check
working_copy: local quality-winner copy (ships only candidate 05B; 05A/05C/05D pulled from the documentation repo)
summary: Across the session: clarified that Challenge 3 has no MicroPython files (it is an FPGA FIR-filter Trojan challenge of CPython tooling run under the OSS CAD Suite); authored portable MicroPython software models of all four Trojan candidates plus a shared FIR core; then cross-checked the three reconstructed candidates against the verbatim GitHub reference scripts, finding and fixing one real discrepancy in 05C.

trojan_candidates.name: Luna
trojan_candidates.trigger: 3-sample knock on the LEFT channel, masked 16-bit, pattern (0x5A3C, 0xC3A5, 0x96E1)
trojan_candidates.payload: sticky LSB flip of the filtered left output from the trigger sample onward

trojan_candidates.name: Astra
trojan_candidates.payload: bypass FIR for 128 frames (raw audio passes through), re-triggerable
trojan_candidates.cross_check: ported bit-for-bit from local source candidate_reference.py

trojan_candidates.name: Opus Architecture
trojan_candidates.trigger: 3-frame knock on an INDEPENDENT RIGHT I2S slot, masked 16-bit, MAGIC (0xC0DE, 0xFACE, 0xBEEF), FSM with restart credit
trojan_candidates.payload: sticky permanent FIR bypass once armed
trojan_candidates.cross_check: discrepancy found and fixed (knock is on an independent right channel, not a mirror of left); verified against a verbatim replica over 400 randomized stereo trials (229 armed)

trojan_candidates.name: Opus DSP
trojan_candidates.trigger: multiplier-free Goertzel single-bin detector at fs/3 (bin k=192, 576-sample window); arms when |s1|+|s2| >= 2^23 (sticky latch)
trojan_candidates.payload: spectral inversion while armed: odd-index taps negated, low-pass becomes high-pass
trojan_candidates.cross_check: matches verbatim reference exactly (recurrence, arm-at-sample-576 timing, odd-tap negation)

files: fir_core.py (shared recovered FIR core + pipeline framing)
